quadrant.title: Views × Intent quadrant
quadrant.subtitle: Every published post on two independent axes: how far it travelled compared with its account's median (×{multiplier} to count as high) and how much of its audience saved it ({saveRate} to count as high). Under {minViews} views the save rate is not readable — the post does not move up. Scores recomputed by the nightly sync.
quadrant.empty: No post can be plotted for this period.
quadrant.warmupHidden: The page's “Excluding warmup” filter is on: warm-up posts are not on this chart. Switch the Warmup filter to “All” to see them.

verdict.intent_faible: Distribution fine, intent low → tighten the product intro.
verdict.distribution_faible: Intent fine, distribution low → change the hook, keep the angle.
verdict.archiver: Neither distribution nor intent → archive after 2 runs.

tooltip.pending: Pending — under {hours} h, too early to judge.
tooltip.breakout: Published inside the window of a big post from the same account: distribution may be borrowed.

unplaced.title: {count, plural, one {# post not plotted} other {# posts not plotted}} out of {total} published in the period.
unplaced.pending: {count, plural, one {# post under {hours} h old} other {# posts under {hours} h old}}: too early to judge.
unplaced.not_measured: {count, plural, one {# post never measured} other {# posts never measured}}: no view reading at all, which is not a zero.
unplaced.no_baseline: {count, plural, one {# post on an account with no reference median} other {# posts on accounts with no reference median}}: fewer than {minPosts} measured posts over {windowDays} days.
unplaced.saves_unavailable: {count, plural, one {# post on a platform that does not expose saves} other {# posts on platforms that do not expose saves}} (Instagram, YouTube): no intent axis possible.
unplaced.saves_collecting: {count, plural, one {# post predating saves collection} other {# posts predating saves collection}}: the measure will land for the next ones.
unplaced.no_views: {count, plural, one {# post with 0 measured views} other {# posts with 0 measured views}}: no denominator for a save rate.
unplaced.notComputed: {count, plural, one {# post not classified yet} other {# posts not classified yet}}: waiting for the next nightly sync.
